#!/usr/bin/env bash # ============================================================================= # guard-yield.sh — the guard register and its 30-day host yield (cycle-129 FR-1) # ============================================================================= # Enumerates every guard Loa ships and joins it with its origin and its yield: # hooks every command registered in .claude/settings.json, parsed against # the canonical schema "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)"/.claude/ [args] # (or the same wrapped in hook-guard.sh); one row per unique script # fences the `# @guard fence:` markers in block-destructive-bash.sh, # cross-checked both ways against its emit_block call sites and # its literal `pattern_id: ""` audit constants # validators the `# @guard validator:` markers in validate-artifact.sh # gates the fixed list in the origin map (each row's `script` must exist) # policies the floor policies in the origin map # Origins, class, status, knob and floor come from .claude/data/guard-origins.yaml; # the floor set must equal .claude/data/floor.yaml floor_guards. # # Outputs: # grimoires/loa/guards.md tracked, STRUCTURAL ONLY (a pure function of the # repository; no timestamp, no yield) — --check gates it # .run/guard-yield.md, .json untracked host yield: blocks_30d, likely_fp_30d, # telemetry_30d, last_real_catch per guard # hooks-reference.md table with --hooks-table, the rows between # and # # Yield (SDD D-1.3): rows of .run/audit.jsonl and its rotated segments # .run/audit.jsonl.* with action == "block", plus implement-gate rows (telemetry # when action is telemetry or ask), with ts inside the window. Replays are # excluded and counted: replay == true (LOA_AUDIT_REPLAY=1 at the source), or, # for rows that predate the flag, a cwd under ${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/ or containing # /bats-run-, /bats., /evals/results/ or /sandbox/, or a UTC minute holding # BURST_ROWS (10) or more block rows (a suite replaying fixtures into the live # log from inside the repository; no interactive session blocks ten commands in # one minute). A block is a likely false # positive (a heuristic) when its command holds a heredoc (`<<`; or, when # .claude/scripts/lib/heredoc-classifier.sh defines heredoc_nonexec, a heredoc # that function calls non-executing), when its cwd lies outside the repository # (this checkout and its main worktree), or when its pattern id is a prose class # (SP-1, FR-MERGE-2, FR-2-AMBIGUOUS) with no destructive verb at statement start. # A real catch is a block that is not a likely false positive. # # Privacy: no command text, cwd, hostname, user or model name is written to any # output; ids match ^[A-Za-z0-9._/:-]+$; origin text comes from the tracked map. # # Usage: # guard-yield.sh [--window-days 30] [--audit-log PATH] [--origins PATH] # [--floor PATH] [--out grimoires/loa/guards.md] [--yield-dir .run] # [--hooks-table] [--check] [--json] [--root DIR] # [--settings PATH] [--fence PATH] [--validator PATH] # [--hooks-ref PATH] [--now YYYY-MM-DD|YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ|EPOCH] # # Exit codes: # 0 written, or in sync (--check) # 1 drift (--check): guards.md or the hooks table differ from what would be written # 2 usage error # 3 unreadable or unparseable input (a missing audit log is a WARN and an empty yield) # 5 a guard without an origin row, a row that resolves to nothing, an invalid row, # a floor mismatch, or a hook command outside the canonical schema # # Tested by tests/unit/guard-yield.bats and tests/unit/guard-origins.bats. # ============================================================================= set -euo pipefail export LC_ALL=C SCRIPT_NAME="guard-yield.sh" SCRIPT_DIR="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd -P)" usage() { sed -n '/^# Usage:/,/^# Tested/p' "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}" | sed -e 's/^# \{0,1\}//' -e '/^Tested/d' } die() { local code="$1"; shift; echo "$SCRIPT_NAME: $*" >&2; exit "$code"; } warn() { echo "$SCRIPT_NAME: WARN: $*" >&2; } ROOT="" WINDOW_DAYS=30 AUDIT_LOG="" ORIGINS="" FLOOR="" OUT="" YIELD_DIR="" HOOKS_REF="" SETTINGS="" FENCE="" VALIDATOR="" NOW="" DO_HOOKS_TABLE=0 DO_CHECK=0 DO_JSON=0 need_arg() { [[ $# -ge 2 && -n "$2" ]] || die 2 "$1 needs a value (see --help)"; } while [[ $# -gt 0 ]]; do case "$1" in --window-days) need_arg "$@"; WINDOW_DAYS="$2"; shift 2 ;; --audit-log) need_arg "$@"; AUDIT_LOG="$2"; shift 2 ;; --origins) need_arg "$@"; ORIGINS="$2"; shift 2 ;; --floor) need_arg "$@"; FLOOR="$2"; shift 2 ;; --out) need_arg "$@"; OUT="$2"; shift 2 ;; --yield-dir) need_arg "$@"; YIELD_DIR="$2"; shift 2 ;; --root) need_arg "$@"; ROOT="$2"; shift 2 ;; --settings) need_arg "$@"; SETTINGS="$2"; shift 2 ;; --fence) need_arg "$@"; FENCE="$2"; shift 2 ;; --validator) need_arg "$@"; VALIDATOR="$2"; shift 2 ;; --hooks-ref) need_arg "$@"; HOOKS_REF="$2"; shift 2 ;; --now) need_arg "$@"; NOW="$2"; shift 2 ;; --hooks-table) DO_HOOKS_TABLE=1; shift ;; --check) DO_CHECK=1; shift ;; --json) DO_JSON=1; shift ;; -h|--help) usage; exit 0 ;; *) die 2 "unknown argument '$1' (see --help)" ;; esac done [[ "$WINDOW_DAYS" =~ ^[0-9]+$ && "$WINDOW_DAYS" -ge 1 && "$WINDOW_DAYS" -le 3650 ]] \ || die 2 "--window-days must be an integer from 1 to 3650 (got '$WINDOW_DAYS')" command -v jq >/dev/null 2>&1 || die 3 "jq is required" command -v yq >/dev/null 2>&1 || die 3 "yq v4 (mikefarah) is required" case "$(yq --version 2>&1 || true)" in *mikefarah*"version v4."*) ;; Day granularity is all any output shows. if [[ -z "$NOW" ]]; then NOW_EPOCH="$(date -u +%s)" elif [[ "$NOW" =~ ^[0-9]+$ ]]; then NOW_EPOCH="$NOW" elif [[ "$NOW" =~ ^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}$ ]]; then NOW_EPOCH="$(jq -rn --arg d "${NOW}T00:00:00Z" '$d | fromdateiso8601')" || die 2 "--now '$NOW' is not a date" elif [[ "$NOW" =~ ^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}T[0-9]{2}:[0-9]{2}:[0-9]{2}Z$ ]]; then NOW_EPOCH="$(jq -rn --arg d "$NOW" '$d | fromdateiso8601')" || die 2 "--now '$NOW' is not a timestamp" else die 2 "--now takes YYYY-MM-DD, YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ or epoch seconds (got '$NOW')" fi TMPWORK="$(mktemp -d "${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/guard-yield.XXXXXX")" cleanup() { rm -rf -- "$TMPWORK"; } trap cleanup EXIT # ----------------------------------------------------------------------------- inputs for f in "$ORIGINS" "$FLOOR" "$SETTINGS" "$FENCE" "$VALIDATOR"; do [[ -f "$f" && -r "$f" ]] || die 3 "input not readable: $f" done MAP_JSON="$(yq -o=json -I0 '.' "$ORIGINS" 2>/dev/null)" || die 3 "origin map does not parse as YAML: $ORIGINS" [[ -n "$MAP_JSON" && "$MAP_JSON" != "null" ]] || die 3 "origin map is empty: $ORIGINS" FLOOR_JSON="$(yq -o=json -I0 '.' "$FLOOR" 2>/dev/null)" || die 3 "floor file does not parse as YAML: $FLOOR" jq -e 'type == "object"' "$SETTINGS" >/dev/null 2>&1 || die 3 "settings file does not parse as a JSON object: $SETTINGS" ERRORS="$TMPWORK/errors" : > "$ERRORS" # ----------------------------------------------------------------------------- map schema jq -r ' def idok: type == "string" and test("^[A-Za-z0-9._/:-]+$"); def nonempty: type == "string" and length > 0; (if .schema_version != 1 then "origin map: schema_version must be 1" else empty end), (if (.guards | type) != "array" then "origin map: guards must be a list" else ((.guards | map(.id) | group_by(.) | map(select(length > 1) | .[0]))[] | "origin map: duplicate id \(tostring)"), (.guards[] | . as $r | ($r.id | tostring) as $id | (if ($r.id | idok | not) then "origin map: row id \($id) does not match ^[A-Za-z0-9._/:-]+$" else empty end), (if (($r.kind // "") | IN("hook","fence","validator","gate","policy") | not) then "\($id): kind must be hook|fence|validator|gate|policy" else empty end), (if ($id | startswith(($r.kind // "?") + ":") | not) then "\($id): the id prefix must equal its kind" else empty end), (if (($r.class // "") | IN("harness","script","prose") | not) then "\($id): class must be harness|script|prose" else empty end), (if (($r.status // "") | IN("active","dormant","telemetry") | not) then "\($id): status must be active|dormant|telemetry" else empty end), (if ($r.origin.ref | nonempty | not) then "guard \($id) has no origin (origin.ref is empty)" else empty end), (if (($r.origin.kind // "") | IN("kf","issue","finding","cycle","design") | not) then "\($id): origin.kind must be kf|issue|finding|cycle|design" else empty end), (if ($r.knob | nonempty | not) then "\($id): knob must be a config key, an env var or none" else empty end), (if ($r.floor | type) != "boolean" then "\($id): floor must be true or false" else empty end), (if (($r.registrations // []) | type != "array" or any(.[]; type != "string")) then "\($id): registrations must be a list of strings" else empty end), (if $r.status == "dormant" and (($r.knob // "") | test("^[A-Z][A-Z0-9_]*$") | not) then "\($id): a dormant row names the arming env var in knob" else empty end), (if ($r.kind == "gate" or $r.kind == "policy") and ($r.script | nonempty | not) then "\($id): gate and policy rows name their script" else empty end), (if ($r.note // "" | type) != "string" then "\($id): note must be a string" else empty end) ) end) ' <<<"$MAP_JSON" >> "$ERRORS" || die 3 "origin map could not be checked: $ORIGINS" if [[ -s "$ERRORS" ]]; then sed "s/^/$SCRIPT_NAME: /" "$ERRORS" >&2 exit 5 fi # ----------------------------------------------------------------------------- hooks # jq parses each registered command against the canonical schema; bash resolves # symlinks once and checks the script exists.    285	aggregate_status() {

   428	PIDS=() PJOB=() PARM=()
   429	reap() {  # reap until fewer than $1 jobs run
   430	  local i

1	#!/usr/bin/env bash
     2	# =============================================================================
     3	# run-arms.sh — cycle-129 FR-2 control-arm driver (SDD D-2.3, DEC-0164, DEC-0171)
     4	#
     5	# Runs the declared control arms of one recall suite on a frozen fixture batch
     6	# against a detached git worktree pinned at --source-commit (never the live
     7	# tree), interleaving trials across arms so provider drift spreads evenly.
     8	#
     9	# Usage:
    10	#   run-arms.sh --suite review-recall|audit-recall --arms a,b,c
    11	#               --fixtures pr-01,pr-02,… --trials 3 --source-commit <sha>
    12	#               [--model <id>] [--concurrency 2] [--batch <name>]
    13	#               [--results-dir evals/results/arms] [--retry-wait <s>]
    14	#               [--allow-unapproved] [--dry-run]
    15	#
    16	# Per trial (fixture × arm × trial), in this order:
    17	#   1. the fixture's SHA256SUMS entries (its files, hidden manifest and labels)
    18	#      are verified; a drift stops the batch (state failed, exit 3). The whole
    19	#      corpus is verified once at batch start (digest in MANIFEST.json); each
    20	#      row records the SHA256SUMS digest seen at its trial, so approving another
    21	#      fixture's labels mid-batch is visible and harmless
    22	#   2. evals/harness/sandbox.sh creates the sandbox from the frozen fixture
    23	#   3. execute-agent.sh runs the executor with EVAL_PROMPT_TREE = the pinned
    24	#      worktree, LOA_EVAL_ARM = the arm (toggles hit the sandbox copy only),
    25	#      LOA_EVAL_SOURCE_COMMIT, EVAL_MODEL
    26	#   4. grade.sh grades it; the row goes to <batch>/<arm>/results.jsonl with
    27	#      arm, trial, source_commit, model_id, seed (null: the CLI route takes
    28	#      none) and run_date; the artifacts go under <batch>/<arm>/artifacts/
    29	#   A trial whose executor fails for a transport reason (timeout, no result
    30	#   event, API error, rate or session limit) is retried once after
    31	#   --retry-wait seconds; a second failure records an error row and the arm
    32	#   ends `partial`. Other executor failures are recorded, not retried.
    33	#
    34	# Layout: <results-dir>/<suite>/<batch>/{MANIFEST.json,STATUS.json,run.log,
    35	#   <arm>/results.jsonl,<arm>/artifacts/…}; <results-dir>/<suite>/STATUS.json
    36	#   aggregates every batch of the suite (the Sprint 2 gate and report.sh
    37	#   --arms read it). STATUS.json: {state: running|complete|partial|failed,
    38	#   per_arm: {<arm>: {trials_done, trials_failed, trials_planned}},
    39	#   source_commit, model_id, started, finished}.
    40	#
    41	# Exit: 0 complete, 1 partial (some trial failed twice; results kept),
    42	#       2 usage / refused before starting, 3 failed (no trial completed, or
    43	#       the corpus drifted mid-run)
    44	#
    45	# Executor: Fable 5.1 (D33, DEC-0164); the default --model is the id the
    46	# local claude CLI accepted on the cycle-129 probe (claude-fable-5-1).
    47	# Tested by evals/tests/run-arms.bats (stubbed CLI; no model call).
    48	# =============================================================================
    49	set -euo pipefail
    50	export LC_ALL=C
    51	
    52	SCRIPT_DIR="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd)"
    53	REPO_ROOT="$(cd "$SCRIPT_DIR/../.." && pwd)"
    54	EVALS_DIR="$REPO_ROOT/evals"
    55	CORPUS_DIR="$EVALS_DIR/fixtures/review-prs"

   132	# verify_corpus [<fixture>] — every SHA256SUMS entry (or one fixture's entries
   133	# and its manifest) hashes as recorded. Prints the SHA256SUMS digest.
   134	verify_corpus() {
   135	  python3 -I - "$CORPUS_DIR" "${1:-}" <<'PY'
   136	import hashlib, os, sys
   137	corpus, only = sys.argv[1], sys.argv[2]
   138	sums = os.path.join(corpus, "SHA256SUMS")
   139	raw = open(sums, "rb").read()
   140	bad = []
   141	for line in raw.decode("utf-8").splitlines():
   142	    if not line.strip():
   143	        continue
   144	    digest, rel = line.split("  ", 1)
   145	    if only and not (rel.startswith(only + "/") or rel == f"manifests/{only}.json" or rel == "corpus.tsv"
   146	                     or rel.startswith(f"labels/{only}.")):
   147	        continue
   148	    p = os.path.join(corpus, rel)
   149	    if not os.path.isfile(p) or hashlib.sha256(open(p, "rb").read()).hexdigest() != digest:
   150	        bad.append(rel)
   151	if bad:
   152	    print("corpus drift: " + ", ".join(bad[:10]), file=sys.stderr)
   153	    sys.exit(1)
   154	print(hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest())
   155	PY
   156	}

1	#!/usr/bin/env python3
     2	"""arms-report.py — the cycle-129 FR-2 control-arm report (SDD D-2.3).
     3	
     4	Invoked by `report.sh --arms`. Reads <results-root>/<suite>/STATUS.json (the
     5	suite aggregate run-arms.sh writes), every batch's MANIFEST.json and
     6	<arm>/results.jsonl, and the suite's pre-registered `ab.threshold` and
     7	`ab.arms`, and writes one markdown report.
     8	
     9	Per arm: recall (mean over defect fixtures of the per-fixture trial mean;
    10	the min, max and spread of the per-trial means), refuted share (cited
    11	findings matching neither a feedback label nor a fix region, over cited
    12	findings, pooled over completed trials), tokens per call, the percentile
    13	bootstrap interval of the recall drop (baseline - arm) resampling fixtures,
    14	the verdict and the missed labels.
    15	
    16	Verdict (pre-registered; never computed for baseline):
    17	  inconclusive  --partial; the run is not complete; a planned fixture lacks
    18	                trials_required completed trials in the arm or the baseline;
    19	                model or source skew; no defect fixture; or only a recall
    20	                rule is violated while the mean drop does not exceed the
    21	                baseline's own trial-to-trial spread (a change too small to name)
    22	  recall loss   the refuted-share rule is violated, or a recall rule is
    23	                violated and the mean drop exceeds the baseline spread
    24	  no recall loss  every rule holds:
    25	                  upper bound of the drop interval <= mean_recall_max_drop
    26	                  arm min trial mean >= baseline min trial mean - min_trial_recall_max_drop
    27	                  arm refuted share <= baseline refuted share + refuted_share_max_rise
    28	An `informational: true` arm's verdict reports a yield only.
    29	
    30	Exit: 0 written, 1 refused (a suite is not complete and --partial was not
    31	given), 2 error. Stdlib only.
    32	"""
    33	import argparse
    34	import datetime
    35	import json
    36	import os
    37	import random
    38	import sys
    39	from collections import Counter, defaultdict
    40	
    41	
    42	def load_yaml_subset(path):
    43	    """The suites are YAML (no stdlib parser); the harness already depends on yq v4."""
    44	    import subprocess
    45	    out = subprocess.run(["yq", "-o=json", ".", path], check=True, capture_output=True, text=True).stdout
    46	    return json.loads(out)
    47	
    48	
    49	def read_jsonl(path):
    50	    rows = []
    51	    if not os.path.isfile(path):
    52	        return rows
    53	    with open(path, encoding="utf-8") as fh:
    54	        for line in fh:
    55	            line = line.strip()
    56	            if line:
    57	                try:
    58	                    rows.append(json.loads(line))
    59	                except ValueError:
    60	                    continue
    61	    return rows
    62	
    63	
    64	def mean(xs):
    65	    xs = [x for x in xs if x is not None]
    66	    return sum(xs) / len(xs) if xs else None
    67	
    68	
    69	def fmt(x, nd=3):
    70	    return "n/a" if x is None else f"{x:.{nd}f}"
    71	
    72	
    73	def recall_details(row):
    74	    for g in row.get("graders") or []:
    75	        if g.get("name") == "recall-vs-defects.sh" and isinstance(g.get("details"), dict):
    76	            return g["details"]
    77	    return None
    78	
    79	
    80	def tokens(row):
    81	    u = (row.get("executor") or {}).get("usage") or {}
    82	    if not u:
    83	        return None
    84	    return sum(int(u.get(k, 0) or 0) for k in
    85	               ("input_tokens", "cache_creation_input_tokens", "cache_read_input_tokens", "output_tokens"))
    86	
    87	
    88	def percentile(sorted_xs, q):
    89	    if not sorted_xs:
    90	        return None
    91	    k = max(0, min(len(sorted_xs) - 1, int(round(q * (len(sorted_xs) - 1)))))
    92	    return sorted_xs[k]
    93	
    94	
    95	def bootstrap(deltas, iterations, level, seed):
    96	    """Percentile bootstrap of the mean of per-fixture deltas (resample fixtures)."""
    97	    if not deltas:
    98	        return None, None
    99	    rng = random.Random(seed)
   100	    n = len(deltas)
   101	    means = sorted(sum(deltas[rng.randrange(n)] for _ in range(n)) / n for _ in range(iterations))
   102	    a = (1.0 - level) / 2.0
   103	    return percentile(means, a), percentile(means, 1.0 - a)
   104	
   105	
   106	class Arm:
   107	    def __init__(self, arm_id):
   108	        self.id = arm_id

   160	        return sorted(f for f, p in self.planted.items() if p > 0 and self.cells.get(f))
   161	
   162	    def fixture_means(self):
   163	        return {f: mean([r for _t, r in self.cells[f]]) for f in self.defect_fixtures()}
   164	
   165	    def trial_means(self):
   166	        by_trial = defaultdict(list)
   167	        for f in self.defect_fixtures():

   176	def suite_report(root, suites_dir, suite, partial, out_lines):
   177	    sdir = os.path.join(root, suite)
   178	    status = {}
   179	    sp = os.path.join(sdir, "STATUS.json")
   180	    if os.path.isfile(sp):
   181	        status = json.load(open(sp, encoding="utf-8"))
   182	    spec = load_yaml_subset(os.path.join(suites_dir, f"{suite}.yaml"))
   183	    ab = spec.get("ab") or {}
   184	    th = ab.get("threshold") or {}

   186	    trials_required = int(th.get("trials_required", 3))
   187	    max_drop = float(th.get("mean_recall_max_drop", 0.10))
   188	    min_trial_drop = float(th.get("min_trial_recall_max_drop", 0.15))
   189	    refuted_rise = float(th.get("refuted_share_max_rise", 0.10))
   190	    bs = th.get("bootstrap") or {}
   191	    iterations = int(bs.get("iterations", 2000))
   192	    level = float(bs.get("level", 0.90))

   194	    planned_fx, planned_arms, manifests = set(), [], []
   195	    arms = {}
   196	    for batch in sorted(os.listdir(sdir)) if os.path.isdir(sdir) else []:
   197	        bdir = os.path.join(sdir, batch)
   198	        mp = os.path.join(bdir, "MANIFEST.json")
   199	        if not os.path.isfile(mp):

   201	        m = json.load(open(mp, encoding="utf-8"))

   203	            continue

   215	
   216	    out_lines.append(f"## {suite}")
   217	    out_lines.append("")
   218	    out_lines.append(f"- STATUS: `{state}`; batches: {', '.join(b.get('batch', '?') for b in status.get('batches', [])) or 'none'}")
   219	    srcs = sorted({m.get('source_commit') for m in manifests})
   220	    models = sorted({m.get('model_id') for m in manifests})
   221	    out_lines.append(f"- source commit(s): {', '.join(f'`{s[:12]}`' for s in srcs if s) or 'n/a'}; executor model requested: {', '.join(f'`{x}`' for x in models if x) or 'n/a'}")
   222	    out_lines.append(f"- planned fixtures ({len(planned_fx)}): {', '.join(sorted(planned_fx)) or 'none'}")
   223	    out_lines.append(f"- threshold: trials_required {trials_required}, mean_recall_max_drop {max_drop}, "
   224	                     f"min_trial_recall_max_drop {min_trial_drop}, refuted_share_max_rise {refuted_rise}, "
   225	                     f"bootstrap {bs.get('method', 'percentile')} {level} over {bs.get('resample', 'fixtures')} x{iterations}")
   226	    out_lines.append("")
   227	
   228	    base = arms.get("baseline")
   229	    base_fm = base.fixture_means() if base else {}
   230	    base_tm = base.trial_means() if base else {}
   231	    base_spread = (max(base_tm.values()) - min(base_tm.values())) if base_tm else None
   232	    base_min = min(base_tm.values()) if base_tm else None
   233	    base_ref = base.refuted_share() if base else None
   234	
   235	    def coverage_gaps(arm):
   236	        gaps = []
   237	        for fx in sorted(planned_fx):
   238	            planted = arm.planted.get(fx)
   239	            n = len(arm.cells.get(fx, [])) if planted else 0
   240	            if planted == 0:
   241	                continue  # a clean fixture carries no recall; refuted share only
   242	            if n < trials_required:
   243	                gaps.append(f"{fx} {n}/{trials_required}")
   244	        return gaps
   245	
   246	    header = ("| arm | trials done | errors | mean recall | min | max | spread | drop vs baseline | "
   247	              f"{int(level * 100)}% CI of drop | refuted share | tokens/call | verdict |")
   248	    out_lines.append(header)
   249	    out_lines.append("|" + "---|" * 12)
   250	    details = []
   251	    verdicts = {}
   252	    for a in order:
   253	        arm = arms[a]
   254	        fm = arm.fixture_means()
   255	        tm = arm.trial_means()
   256	        m = mean(list(fm.values()))
   257	        mn = min(tm.values()) if tm else None
   258	        mx = max(tm.values()) if tm else None
   259	        spread = (mx - mn) if tm else None
   260	        rs = arm.refuted_share()
   261	        tok = mean(arm.tokens)
   262	        drop = lo = hi = None
   263	        reasons = []
   264	        if a == "baseline":
   265	            verdict = "(reference)"
   266	        else:

   268	            deltas = [base_fm[f] - fm[f] for f in common]
   269	            drop = mean(deltas)

   274	                reasons.append(f"run state is {state}")
   275	            if base is None:
   276	                reasons.append("no baseline arm")
   277	            gaps = coverage_gaps(arm) + ([f"baseline {g}" for g in coverage_gaps(base)] if base else [])
   278	            if gaps:
   279	                reasons.append("coverage: " + ", ".join(gaps[:8]) + (" …" if len(gaps) > 8 else ""))
   280	            mods = {x for x in arm.models | (base.models if base else set()) if x}
   281	            if len(mods) > 1:
   282	                reasons.append("model skew: " + ", ".join(sorted(mods)))
   283	            srcs_a = {x for x in arm.sources | (base.sources if base else set()) if x}
   284	            if len(srcs_a) > 1:
   285	                reasons.append("source skew: " + ", ".join(sorted(s[:12] for s in srcs_a)))
   286	            if not deltas:
   287	                reasons.append("no defect fixture graded in both arms")

   289	                verdict = "inconclusive"
   290	            else:

   292	                if hi is None or hi > max_drop:
   293	                    violated.append(f"drop CI upper {fmt(hi)} > {max_drop}")
   294	                if mn is None or base_min is None or mn < base_min - min_trial_drop:
   295	                    violated.append(f"min trial {fmt(mn)} < baseline min {fmt(base_min)} - {min_trial_drop}")
   296	                if rs is not None and base_ref is not None and rs > base_ref + refuted_rise:
   297	                    violated.append(f"refuted share {fmt(rs)} > baseline {fmt(base_ref)} + {refuted_rise}")
   298	                    refuted_violated = True
   299	                if not violated:
   300	                    verdict = "no recall loss"
   301	                elif (not refuted_violated and drop is not None and base_spread is not None
   302	                      and abs(drop) <= base_spread):
   303	                    # only recall rules failed and the mean moved less than the
   304	                    # baseline moves against itself: too small a change to name
   305	                    verdict = "inconclusive"
   306	                    reasons.append("rule violated (" + "; ".join(violated) + f") but |drop| {fmt(abs(drop))} "
   307	                                   f"<= baseline spread {fmt(base_spread)}: no change can be named")
   308	                else:
   309	                    verdict = "recall loss"
   310	                    reasons.extend(violated)
   311	            if (arm_meta.get(a) or {}).get("informational"):
   312	                verdict += " (informational: yield only)"
   313	        verdicts[a] = verdict
   314	        out_lines.append(
   315	            f"| `{a}` | {arm.done} | {arm.errors} | {fmt(m)} | {fmt(mn)} | {fmt(mx)} | {fmt(spread)} | "
   316	            f"{fmt(drop)} | {('[' + fmt(lo) + ', ' + fmt(hi) + ']') if lo is not None else 'n/a'} | "
   317	            f"{fmt(rs)} | {('%.0f' % tok) if tok is not None else 'n/a'} | **{verdict}** |")
   318	        if arm.fallback_trials:
   319	            reasons.append(f"{arm.fallback_trials}/{arm.done} trial(s) fell back to another model on a safeguard refusal: "
   320	                           + ", ".join(f"{k} x{n}" for k, n in arm.fallback_kinds.most_common()))
   321	        if reasons:
   322	            details.append(f"- `{a}`: " + "; ".join(reasons))
   323	        if a != "baseline" and drop is not None and base_spread is not None:
   324	            named = "named" if abs(drop) > base_spread else "not named (within the baseline's own spread)"
   325	            details.append(f"- `{a}`: mean drop {fmt(drop)} vs baseline spread {fmt(base_spread)}: change {named}")
   326	    out_lines.append("")
   327	    if details:
   328	        out_lines.append("Verdict notes:")
   329	        out_lines.extend(details)
   330	        out_lines.append("")
   331	    out_lines.append("### Missed labels")
   332	    out_lines.append("")
   333	    for a in order:
   334	        arm = arms[a]
   335	        items = sorted(arm.missed.items(), key=lambda kv: (-kv[1], kv[0]))
   336	        if not items:
   337	            out_lines.append(f"- `{a}`: none")
   338	            continue
   339	        shown = ", ".join(f"{fx}:{lbl} ({n}/{arm.seen[(fx, lbl)]})" for (fx, lbl), n in items[:40])
   340	        more = f" … and {len(items) - 40} more" if len(items) > 40 else ""
   341	        out_lines.append(f"- `{a}`: {shown}{more}")
   342	    out_lines.append("")
   343	    return state, verdicts
   344	
   345	
   346	def main():
   347	    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser()
   348	    ap.add_argument("--results-root", required=True)
   349	    ap.add_argument("--suites-dir", required=True)
   350	    ap.add_argument("--suites", default="")
   351	    ap.add_argument("--out", required=True)
   352	    ap.add_argument("--partial", action="store_true")
   353	    ap.add_argument("--date", default=datetime.date.today().isoformat())
   354	    args = ap.parse_args()
   355	
   356	    suites = [s for s in args.suites.split(",") if s] or sorted(
   357	        s for s in ("review-recall", "audit-recall") if os.path.isdir(os.path.join(args.results_root, s)))
   358	    if not suites:
   359	        print(f"arms-report: no suite results under {args.results_root}", file=sys.stderr)
   360	        return 2
   361	    for s in suites:
   362	        if not os.path.isdir(os.path.join(args.results_root, s)):
   363	            print(f"arms-report: no results for suite {s} under {args.results_root}", file=sys.stderr)
   364	            return 2
   365	        st = {}
   366	        sp = os.path.join(args.results_root, s, "STATUS.json")
   367	        if os.path.isfile(sp):
   368	            st = json.load(open(sp, encoding="utf-8"))
   369	        if st.get("state") != "complete" and not args.partial:
   370	            print(f"arms-report: {s} STATUS.json state is {st.get('state', 'missing')!r}, not 'complete'; "
   371	                  "refusing to write a verdict report (pass --partial for an inconclusive interim report)",
   372	                  file=sys.stderr)
   373	            return 1
   374	
   375	    lines = [f"# Control-arm report — {args.date}", ""]
   376	    if args.partial:
   377	        lines += ["> **PARTIAL REPORT.** Written with `--partial` before every run completed: every verdict "
   378	                  "below reads `inconclusive` and none licenses a deletion (SDD D-2.3).", ""]
   379	    lines += ["Generated by `evals/harness/report.sh --arms` from `" + args.results_root + "`. "
   380	              "Recall is graded by `recall-vs-defects.sh` (planted defects and approved record labels); "
   381	              "refuted share counts cited findings that match neither a label nor a fix region. "
   382	              "A deletion that relies on an arm requires the lead to read that arm's missed labels and record the reading.", ""]
   383	    for s in suites:
   384	        suite_report(args.results_root, args.suites_dir, s, args.partial, lines)
   385	    os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(args.out)), exist_ok=True)
   386	    with open(args.out, "w", encoding="utf-8") as fh:
   387	        fh.write("\n".join(lines).rstrip() + "\n")
   388	    print(args.out)
   389	    return 0

   391	
   392	if __name__ == "__main__":
   393	    sys.exit(main())

     3	# seed-corpus-from-record.sh — build a review-recall fixture from a shipped
     4	# sprint's round-1 state and its record-branch feedback (cycle-129 FR-2,
     5	# SDD D-2.2, DEC-0154)
     6	#
     7	# Usage:
     8	#   seed-corpus-from-record.sh <global-sprint> <record-ref> [--out <corpus>/pr-NN]
     9	#                              [--base <rev>] [--head <rev>] [--fix <rev>]
    10	#                              [--feedback a.md,b.md] [--dry-run]
    11	#   seed-corpus-from-record.sh --build-manifest pr-NN   # labels → hidden manifest (after curation)
    12	#   seed-corpus-from-record.sh --approve pr-NN --by "<who> <YYYY-MM-DD>"
    13	#   seed-corpus-from-record.sh --freeze                 # regenerate SHA256SUMS
    14	#   seed-corpus-from-record.sh --check                  # verify SHA256SUMS
    15	#   common: [--repo <git dir>] [--corpus <evals/fixtures/review-prs>]
    16	#
    17	# Without --base/--head/--fix/--feedback/--out the sprint's row in
    18	# <corpus>/record-pairs.tsv supplies them.
    19	#
    20	# Writes (seed):
    21	#   <corpus>/pr-NN/{fixture.yaml, head.diff, PR.md, REVIEW-INSTRUCTIONS.md,
    22	#                   AUDIT-INSTRUCTIONS.md, base/…, head/…}     (copied into the sandbox)
    23	#   <corpus>/labels/pr-NN.tsv          HIDDEN (never copied into a sandbox): the labels,
    24	#                                      first line `# approved-by: pending`
    25	#   <corpus>/labels/pr-NN.dropped.txt  HIDDEN: every finding that did not become a label, and why
    26	#   <corpus>/manifests/pr-NN.json      HIDDEN: the graded manifest (`approved: false` until --approve)
    27	#   <corpus>/corpus.tsv                one `record` row per fixture (or a `#` gap comment)
    28	#   evals/tasks/{review,audit}-recall/{review,audit}-pr-NN.yaml
    29	#   <corpus>/SHA256SUMS                refreshed
    30	#
    31	# Scope: the fixture is the change base..head without the generated or state
    32	# files (grimoires/, CHANGELOG.md, .claude/checksums.json, REPO-MAP.md, lock
    33	# files, .beads/, .run/, evals/results/) and without binaries.
    34	#
    35	# Label rule: a feedback finding becomes a label only when the fix commit
    36	# touches the file it cites (`git diff --name-only head..fix`) and that file
    37	# is part of the fixture; label_source is review (engineer-feedback*,
    38	# reviewer*), audit (auditor-sprint-feedback*) or bridgebuilder
    39	# (bridgebuilder*, the "Fixed" table only). The anchor is a head-side line
    40	# the fix changed near the cited line or inside the cited symbol; a finding
    41	# that cites only a file is anchored on that file's fix hunks when there are
    42	# at most four, else dropped. `fix` rows cover every hunk fix_commit changed

# before another digit, after it (dates such as 2026-10-05 / 2026–10–05 never
# parse; an open `:369-...` still cites 369) — sprint-250 review run 2, #13

    r'(?P<path>[A-Za-z0-9_./+()-]+\.[A-Za-z0-9]{1,6})[`*)]{0,3}:(?P<first>' + RNG
    + r'(?:[ \t]*,[ \t]*' + RNG + r')*)'
    # head:N / base:N keep the 1.1.0 boundary set ("head:40" binds); the JSON
    # punctuation set, plus a CLOSING backtick (one after a token character:
    # `rows`:40, `"high"`:3), guards only the fully bare :N — an opening
    # backtick (`:7`, (`:212`)) still binds (RG-13) — run 2, #14
    r'|(?:(?<![A-Za-z0-9_./:])(?:head|base)|(?<![A-Za-z0-9_./:"\'{}\[\]*])(?<![A-Za-z0-9_"\'}\]]`)):(?P<bare>' + RNG + r')')
ONE = re.compile(RNG)
cites = []
last = None

# One pattern strips and reads it (tolerant whitespace, line breaks); the body
# may not contain another comment's `<!--` or `-->`, so an unterminated
# `<!-- LOA-VERDICT` strips nothing — sprint-250 review run 2, #15
TRAILER = re.compile(r'<!--\s*LOA-VERDICT\s*(\{(?:(?!<!--|-->).)*\})\s*-->', re.S)
body = TRAILER.sub('', text)
URL = re.compile(r'[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9+.-]*://|^//')

    if m.group("path") is not None:
        # a URL (https://h/x.js:8080, //host.com:8080) is not a path, nor is a
        # partial match that starts later inside the URL token
        # (https://u@h.com/x.js:8080 matches `h.com/x.js`) — run 2, #11
        # the token so far is the window's text after its last whitespace —

regions = []

    except Exception:

model = effort = None
tokens = None

    u = ex.get("usage") or {}
    # every token the call consumed: uncached input, cache writes, cache

    13	
    14	NOW="2026-10-14T12:00:00Z"
    15	
    16	setup() {
    17	  export LOA_AUDIT_REPLAY=1
    18	  ROOT="$(cd "$BATS_TEST_DIRNAME/../.." && pwd -P)"
    19	  GY="$ROOT/.claude/scripts/guard-yield.sh"
    20	  T="$(mktemp -d "${BATS_TEST_TMPDIR:-/tmp}/gyield.XXXXXX")"
    21	  T="$(cd "$T" && pwd -P)"
    22	  mkdir -p "$T/run" "$T/scratch"
    23	  # A temp prefix the fixture controls (the script's own mktemp also uses it).

    28	  row() {  # ts pattern cwd command [extra-json]
    29	    jq -cn --arg ts "$1" --arg p "$2" --arg cwd "$3" --arg c "$4" --argjson x "${5:-{\}}" \
    30	      '{ts: $ts, tool: "Bash", command: $c, exit_code: 2, cwd: $cwd, model: "claude-test-model", hook: "block-destructive-bash", action: "block", pattern_id: $p, matched: "m"} + $x'
    31	  }
    32	  {
    33	    # live, inside the repo
    34	    row "2026-10-12T08:00:00Z" "FR-SZ2-REDIR" "$ROOT" "cat > .claude/x.md <<'EOF'"            # heredoc → likely FP
    35	    row "2026-10-12T09:00:00Z" "P2" "/srv/elsewhere/scratch" "git push --force origin topic"    # outside repo → likely FP
    36	    row "2026-10-12T10:00:00Z" "SP-1" "$ROOT" "br comments add bd-1 'note about spike/x merge'" # prose class, no verb → likely FP
    37	    row "2026-10-13T23:59:00Z" "FR-2-AMBIGUOUS" "$ROOT" "cd sub && rm -rf ./.cache"             # prose class WITH verb → real
    38	    # replays
    39	    row "2026-10-11T08:00:00Z" "P3" "$ROOT" "git reset --hard HEAD~1" '{"replay": true}'        # flag
    40	    row "2026-10-11T09:00:00Z" "P3" "$T/scratch" "git reset --hard HEAD~2"                       # cwd under TMPDIR
    41	    row "2026-10-11T10:00:00Z" "P3" "/home/u/bats-run-42/repo" "git reset --hard HEAD~3"        # cwd /bats-run-
    42	    for s in 00 01 02 03 04 05 06 07 08 09; do                                                  # burst: 10 in one minute
    43	      row "2026-10-09T10:00:${s}Z" "P2" "$ROOT" "git push --force origin main"
    44	    done

    46	    row "2026-08-01T08:00:00Z" "P3" "$ROOT" "git reset --hard HEAD~9"

    48	    jq -cn '{ts: "2026-10-12T11:00:00Z", hook: "implement-gate", action: "telemetry", cwd: "x"}'
    49	    jq -cn '{ts: "2026-10-12T11:05:00Z", hook: "implement-gate", action: "ask", cwd: "x"}'

    52	    printf 'this is not json\n'
    53	  } > "$A"
    54	  # the rotated segment holds the one real P3 catch
    55	  row "2026-10-10T09:00:00Z" "P3" "$ROOT" "git reset --hard HEAD~3" > "$A.1"
    56	  ARGS=(--now "$NOW" --audit-log "$A" --origins "$T/origins.yaml" --out "$T/guards.md" --yield-dir "$T/run" --hooks-ref "$T/hooks-reference.md")
    57	}

    97	  [ -z "$(jq -r '.guards[].last_real_catch' "$J" | grep -vE '^([0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}|none in window|n/a)$' || true)" ]
    98	  [ "$(g gate:implement-gate)" = '[0,0,2,"none in window"]' ]
    99	  [ "$(g hook:compliance/implement-gate.sh)" = '[0,0,2,"none in window"]' ]
   100	  [ "$(g hook:safety/zone-write-guard.sh)" = '[null,null,null,"n/a"]' ]
   101	  grep -qE '^\| hook:safety/zone-write-guard.sh \|.*\| n/a \| n/a \| n/a \| n/a \|$' "$T/run/guard-yield.md"
   102	}

   104	@test "GY-5 no command text, cwd, hostname or model name reaches guards.md, the yield files or the hooks table" {
   105	  run bash "$GY" "${ARGS[@]}" --hooks-table
   106	  [ "$status" -eq 0 ]
   107	  # the hooks reference documents fence commands in its own prose; only the generated block is checked
   108	  awk '/^<!-- guard-register:begin -->$/,/^<!-- guard-register:end -->$/' "$T/hooks-reference.md" > "$T/hooks-block.md"
   109	  [ -s "$T/hooks-block.md" ]

   111	    for needle in "reset --hard" "push --force" "rm -rf" "spike/x merge" "<<'EOF'" "/srv/elsewhere" "bats-run-42" "$T" "claude-test-model" "$(hostname)"; do
   112	      if grep -qF -- "$needle" "$f"; then echo "$f leaks '$needle'" >&2; false; fi
   113	    done
   114	  done
   115	}

   118	  run bash "$GY" "${ARGS[@]}"

1	#!/usr/bin/env bash
     2	# =============================================================================
     3	# tools/cycle-ratio.sh: the two release-notes lines of a cycle, task-kind
     4	# counts and the volume ratio (grimoires/loa/sdd.md D-10.3, PRD FR-10).
     5	#
     6	#   kinds: mechanical N · judgment N · operator N
     7	#   volume: script lines changed N (*.sh *.py *.ts *.js) · prose bytes changed N (*.md) · model calls N (MODELINV rows between the two commits' timestamps) · scope: host · modelinv: <path>
     8	#
     9	# Mapping (the glossary's "Kind counts" and "Volume ratio" entries):
    10	#   kinds          the 'kind: <value>' token that ends each top-level '- [ ]' /
    11	#                  '- [x]' task line under '### Technical Tasks', and each
    12	#                  '- [ ] Task ...' line under a '### Task N.E2E' heading, inside
    13	#                  a '## Sprint N' block of the sprint plan (fenced code skipped,
    14	#                  the same scope validate-artifact.sh --type sprint enforces);
    15	#                  untagged task lines are counted in --json and WARNed
    16	#   script lines   added + deleted lines of *.sh *.py *.ts *.js files between
    17	#                  the two commits (git diff --numstat, renames detected,
    18	#                  binary files skipped)
    19	#   prose bytes    bytes of the added and removed *.md lines between the two
    20	#                  commits, newline included, diff markers excluded
    21	#   model calls    MODELINV rows (primitive_id MODELINV) in the MODELINV log
    22	#                  whose ts_utc lies between the two commits' committer
    23	#                  timestamps, both ends included. The log is host-local, so
    24	#                  the count covers only the calls made on this host: "scope:
    25	#                  host". A missing log prints "model calls n/a" and a WARN.
    26	#
    27	# Git runs in the current directory's repository; --sprint-plan and --modelinv
    28	# default to paths under its top level.
    29	#
    30	# Usage:
    31	#   tools/cycle-ratio.sh --from SHA --to SHA [--sprint-plan PATH]
    32	#                        [--modelinv PATH] [--json]
    33	#
    34	#   --sprint-plan PATH  default grimoires/loa/sprint.md
    35	#   --modelinv PATH     default .run/model-invoke.jsonl
    36	#   --json              one JSON object instead of the two lines
    37	#
    38	# Exit 2 also covers: not a git repository, an unreadable sprint plan, jq missing.
    39	# Exit codes: 0 printed · 2 usage or unreadable input · 3 a SHA names no commit
    40	# =============================================================================
    41	set -euo pipefail
    42	export LC_ALL=C
    43	
    44	usage() { sed -n '/^# Usage:/,/^# Exit codes/p' "$0" | sed 's/^# \{0,1\}//'; }
    45	die() { echo "cycle-ratio.sh: $2" >&2; exit "$1"; }
    46	
    47	SCRIPT_ROOT="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")/.." && pwd)"
    48	FENCE_AWK="$SCRIPT_ROOT/.claude/scripts/lib/md-fence.awk"
    49	
    50	FROM=""
    51	TO=""
    52	PLAN=""
    53	MODELINV=""
    54	JSON=0
    55	while [[ $# -gt 0 ]]; do
    56	  case "$1" in
    57	    --from|--to|--sprint-plan|--modelinv)
    58	      [[ $# -ge 2 && -n "$2" ]] || { echo "cycle-ratio.sh: $1 needs a value" >&2; usage >&2; exit 2; }
    59	      case "$1" in
    60	        --from) FROM="$2" ;;
    61	        --to) TO="$2" ;;
    62	        --sprint-plan) PLAN="$2" ;;
    63	        --modelinv) MODELINV="$2" ;;
    64	      esac
    65	      shift 2 ;;
    66	    --json) JSON=1; shift ;;
    67	    --help|-h) usage; exit 0 ;;
    68	    *) echo "cycle-ratio.sh: unknown argument $1" >&2; usage >&2; exit 2 ;;
    69	  esac
    70	done
    71	
    72	[[ -n "$FROM" && -n "$TO" ]] || { echo "cycle-ratio.sh: --from and --to are required" >&2; usage >&2; exit 2; }
    73	command -v jq >/dev/null 2>&1 || die 2 "jq is required"
    74	TOP="$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null)" || die 2 "not inside a git repository"
    75	[[ -n "$PLAN" ]] || PLAN="$TOP/grimoires/loa/sprint.md"
    76	[[ -n "$MODELINV" ]] || MODELINV="$TOP/.run/model-invoke.jsonl"
    77	[[ -r "$PLAN" && -f "$PLAN" ]] || die 2 "sprint plan not readable: $PLAN"
    78	[[ -r "$FENCE_AWK" ]] || die 2 "cannot read $FENCE_AWK (reinstall the framework scripts)"
    79	
    80	# A leading '-' would reach git as an option; a SHA never starts with one.
    81	case "$FROM" in -*) die 3 "unknown commit: $FROM" ;; esac
    82	case "$TO" in -*) die 3 "unknown commit: $TO" ;; esac
    83	FROM_SHA="$(git rev-parse --verify --quiet "${FROM}^{commit}")" || die 3 "unknown commit: $FROM"
    84	TO_SHA="$(git rev-parse --verify --quiet "${TO}^{commit}")" || die 3 "unknown commit: $TO"
    85	
    86	# --- kinds -------------------------------------------------------------------
    87	kinds="$(awk "$(cat "$FENCE_AWK")"'
    88	  md_fence($0) { next }
    89	  /^## / { insp = ($0 ~ /^## Sprint [0-9]/); sec = 0; next }
    90	  !insp { next }
    91	  /^### / {
    92	    sec = 0
    93	    if ($0 ~ /^### Technical Tasks[[:space:]]*$/) sec = 1
    94	    else if ($0 ~ /^### Task [0-9A-Za-z]+\.E2E([^A-Za-z0-9]|$)/) sec = 2
    95	    next
    96	  }
    97	  !sec || $0 !~ /^- \[[ xX]\] / { next }
    98	  sec == 2 && $0 !~ /^- \[[ xX]\] Task / { next }
    99	  {
   100	    if (match($0, /(^|[^A-Za-z0-9_])kind[[:space:]]*:[[:space:]]*(mechanical|judgment|operator)[[:space:]]*$/)) {
   101	      v = substr($0, RSTART, RLENGTH)
   102	      sub(/^.*:[[:space:]]*/, "", v); sub(/[[:space:]]+$/, "", v)
   103	      n[v]++
   104	    } else n["untagged"]++
   105	  }
   106	  END { printf "%d %d %d %d\n", n["mechanical"], n["judgment"], n["operator"], n["untagged"] }
   107	' "$PLAN")"
   108	read -r K_MECH K_JUDG K_OPER K_UNTAGGED <<< "$kinds"
   109	[[ "$K_UNTAGGED" -eq 0 ]] || echo "WARN: $K_UNTAGGED task line(s) in $PLAN carry no kind: tag and are not counted" >&2
   110	
   111	# --- volume ------------------------------------------------------------------
   112	GIT_DIFF=(git -c core.quotePath=false diff --no-color --no-ext-diff --no-textconv -M)
   113	SCRIPT_LINES="$("${GIT_DIFF[@]}" --numstat "$FROM_SHA" "$TO_SHA" -- '*.sh' '*.py' '*.ts' '*.js' \
   114	  | awk -F'\t' '$1 ~ /^[0-9]+$/ && $2 ~ /^[0-9]+$/ { s += $1 + $2 } END { printf "%d\n", s }')"
   115	PROSE_BYTES="$("${GIT_DIFF[@]}" --unified=0 "$FROM_SHA" "$TO_SHA" -- '*.md' \
   116	  | awk '
   117	      /^diff --git / { hunk = 0; next }
   118	      /^@@ / { hunk = 1; next }
   119	      # the marker byte stands in for the newline the diff line drops
   120	      hunk && /^[+-]/ { s += length($0) }
   121	      END { printf "%d\n", s }
   122	    ')"
   123	
   124	# --- model calls -------------------------------------------------------------
   125	FROM_TS="$(git show -s --format=%ct "$FROM_SHA")"
   126	TO_TS="$(git show -s --format=%ct "$TO_SHA")"
   127	MODEL_CALLS=""
   128	if [[ -f "$MODELINV" && -r "$MODELINV" ]]; then
   129	  MODEL_CALLS="$(jq -R --argjson lo "$FROM_TS" --argjson hi "$TO_TS" '
   130	      fromjson? | select(type == "object" and .primitive_id == "MODELINV")
   131	      | (.ts_utc // "") | tostring
   132	      | (try (sub("\\.[0-9]+"; "") | sub("\\+00:00$"; "Z") | fromdateiso8601) catch null)
   133	      | select(. != null and . >= $lo and . <= $hi)
   134	    ' "$MODELINV" | wc -l | tr -d ' ')"
   135	else
   136	  echo "WARN: MODELINV log not found at $MODELINV; model calls n/a" >&2
   137	fi
   138	
   139	iso() { jq -nr --argjson t "$1" '$t | todateiso8601'; }
   140	
   141	if [[ "$JSON" -eq 1 ]]; then
   142	  jq -n \
   143	    --arg from "$FROM_SHA" --arg to "$TO_SHA" \
   144	    --arg from_ts "$(iso "$FROM_TS")" --arg to_ts "$(iso "$TO_TS")" \
   145	    --arg plan "$PLAN" --arg modelinv "$MODELINV" \
   146	    --argjson mech "$K_MECH" --argjson judg "$K_JUDG" --argjson oper "$K_OPER" --argjson untagged "$K_UNTAGGED" \
   147	    --argjson script_lines "$SCRIPT_LINES" --argjson prose_bytes "$PROSE_BYTES" \
   148	    --arg calls "$MODEL_CALLS" \
   149	    '{from: $from, to: $to, window: {from: $from_ts, to: $to_ts}, sprint_plan: $plan,
   150	      kinds: {mechanical: $mech, judgment: $judg, operator: $oper, untagged: $untagged},
   151	      volume: {script_lines_changed: $script_lines, prose_bytes_changed: $prose_bytes,
   152	               model_calls: (if $calls == "" then null else ($calls | tonumber) end),
   153	               scope: "host", modelinv: $modelinv}}'
   154	else
   155	  printf 'kinds: mechanical %s · judgment %s · operator %s\n' "$K_MECH" "$K_JUDG" "$K_OPER"
   156	  printf "volume: script lines changed %s (*.sh *.py *.ts *.js) · prose bytes changed %s (*.md) · model calls %s (MODELINV rows between the two commits' timestamps) · scope: host · modelinv: %s\n" \
   157	    "$SCRIPT_LINES" "$PROSE_BYTES" "${MODEL_CALLS:-n/a}" "$MODELINV"
   158	fi

    17	#                  the two commits (git diff --numstat, renames detected,

    20	#                  commits, newline included, diff markers excluded

    24	#                  the count covers only the calls made on this host: "scope:
    25	#                  host". A missing log prints "model calls n/a" and a WARN.
    26	#
    27	# Git runs in the current directory's repository; --sprint-plan and --modelinv
    28	# default to paths under its top level.
    29	#
    30	# Usage:
    31	#   tools/cycle-ratio.sh --from SHA --to SHA [--sprint-plan PATH]
    32	#                        [--modelinv PATH] [--json]
    33	#
    34	#   --sprint-plan PATH  default grimoires/loa/sprint.md

    42	export LC_ALL=C

    44	usage() { sed -n '/^# Usage:/,/^# Exit codes/p' "$0" | sed 's/^# \{0,1\}//'; }

    47	SCRIPT_ROOT="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")/.." && pwd)"
    48	FENCE_AWK="$SCRIPT_ROOT/.claude/scripts/lib/md-fence.awk"

    50	FROM=""
    51	TO=""
    52	PLAN=""
    53	MODELINV=""

    57	    --from|--to|--sprint-plan|--modelinv)

    59	      case "$1" in
    60	        --from) FROM="$2" ;;
    61	        --to) TO="$2" ;;
    62	        --sprint-plan) PLAN="$2" ;;
    63	        --modelinv) MODELINV="$2" ;;
    64	      esac
    65	      shift 2 ;;
    66	    --json) JSON=1; shift ;;
    67	    --help|-h) usage; exit 0 ;;
    68	    *) echo "cycle-ratio.sh: unknown argument $1" >&2; usage >&2; exit 2 ;;
    69	  esac
    70	done
    71	
    72	[[ -n "$FROM" && -n "$TO" ]] || { echo "cycle-ratio.sh: --from and --to are required" >&2; usage >&2; exit 2; }
    73	command -v jq >/dev/null 2>&1 || die 2 "jq is required"
    74	TOP="$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null)" || die 2 "not inside a git repository"

    77	[[ -r "$PLAN" && -f "$PLAN" ]] || die 2 "sprint plan not readable: $PLAN"
    78	[[ -r "$FENCE_AWK" ]] || die 2 "cannot read $FENCE_AWK (reinstall the framework scripts)"
    79	
    80	# A leading '-' would reach git as an option; a SHA never starts with one.
    81	case "$FROM" in -*) die 3 "unknown commit: $FROM" ;; esac

    83	FROM_SHA="$(git rev-parse --verify --quiet "${FROM}^{commit}")" || die 3 "unknown commit: $FROM"
    84	TO_SHA="$(git rev-parse --verify --quiet "${TO}^{commit}")" || die 3 "unknown commit: $TO"
    85	
    86	# --- kinds -------------------------------------------------------------------
    87	kinds="$(awk "$(cat "$FENCE_AWK")"'
    88	  md_fence($0) { next }
    89	  /^## / { insp = ($0 ~ /^## Sprint [0-9]/); sec = 0; next }
    90	  !insp { next }
    91	  /^### / {
    92	    sec = 0
    93	    if ($0 ~ /^### Technical Tasks[[:space:]]*$/) sec = 1
    94	    else if ($0 ~ /^### Task [0-9A-Za-z]+\.E2E([^A-Za-z0-9]|$)/) sec = 2
    95	    next
    96	  }
    97	  !sec || $0 !~ /^- \[[ xX]\] / { next }
    98	  sec == 2 && $0 !~ /^- \[[ xX]\] Task / { next }
    99	  {
   100	    if (match($0, /(^|[^A-Za-z0-9_])kind[[:space:]]*:[[:space:]]*(mechanical|judgment|operator)[[:space:]]*$/)) {
   101	      v = substr($0, RSTART, RLENGTH)

   106	  END { printf "%d %d %d %d\n", n["mechanical"], n["judgment"], n["operator"], n["untagged"] }
   107	' "$PLAN")"
   108	read -r K_MECH K_JUDG K_OPER K_UNTAGGED <<< "$kinds"
   109	[[ "$K_UNTAGGED" -eq 0 ]] || echo "WARN: $K_UNTAGGED task line(s) in $PLAN carry no kind: tag and are not counted" >&2
   110	
   111	# --- volume ------------------------------------------------------------------
   112	GIT_DIFF=(git -c core.quotePath=false diff --no-color --no-ext-diff --no-textconv -M)
   113	SCRIPT_LINES="$("${GIT_DIFF[@]}" --numstat "$FROM_SHA" "$TO_SHA" -- '*.sh' '*.py' '*.ts' '*.js' \
   114	  | awk -F'\t' '$1 ~ /^[0-9]+$/ && $2 ~ /^[0-9]+$/ { s += $1 + $2 } END { printf "%d\n", s }')"
   115	PROSE_BYTES="$("${GIT_DIFF[@]}" --unified=0 "$FROM_SHA" "$TO_SHA" -- '*.md' \
   116	  | awk '
   117	      /^diff --git / { hunk = 0; next }
   118	      /^@@ / { hunk = 1; next }
   119	      # the marker byte stands in for the newline the diff line drops
   120	      hunk && /^[+-]/ { s += length($0) }
   121	      END { printf "%d\n", s }
   122	    ')"
   123	
   124	# --- model calls -------------------------------------------------------------
   125	FROM_TS="$(git show -s --format=%ct "$FROM_SHA")"
   126	TO_TS="$(git show -s --format=%ct "$TO_SHA")"
   127	MODEL_CALLS=""
   128	if [[ -f "$MODELINV" && -r "$MODELINV" ]]; then
   129	  MODEL_CALLS="$(jq -R --argjson lo "$FROM_TS" --argjson hi "$TO_TS" '
   130	      fromjson? | select(type == "object" and .primitive_id == "MODELINV")
   131	      | (.ts_utc // "") | tostring
   132	      | (try (sub("\\.[0-9]+"; "") | sub("\\+00:00$"; "Z") | fromdateiso8601) catch null)
   133	      | select(. != null and . >= $lo and . <= $hi)
   134	    ' "$MODELINV" | wc -l | tr -d ' ')"
   135	else
   136	  echo "WARN: MODELINV log not found at $MODELINV; model calls n/a" >&2
   137	fi
   138	
   139	iso() { jq -nr --argjson t "$1" '$t | todateiso8601'; }
   140	
   141	if [[ "$JSON" -eq 1 ]]; then
   142	  jq -n \
   143	    --arg from "$FROM_SHA" --arg to "$TO_SHA" \
   144	    --arg from_ts "$(iso "$FROM_TS")" --arg to_ts "$(iso "$TO_TS")" \
   145	    --arg plan "$PLAN" --arg modelinv "$MODELINV" \
   146	    --argjson mech "$K_MECH" --argjson judg "$K_JUDG" --argjson oper "$K_OPER" --argjson untagged "$K_UNTAGGED" \
   147	    --argjson script_lines "$SCRIPT_LINES" --argjson prose_bytes "$PROSE_BYTES" \
   148	    --arg calls "$MODEL_CALLS" \
   149	    '{from: $from, to: $to, window: {from: $from_ts, to: $to_ts}, sprint_plan: $plan,
   150	      kinds: {mechanical: $mech, judgment: $judg, operator: $oper, untagged: $untagged},
   151	      volume: {script_lines_changed: $script_lines, prose_bytes_changed: $prose_bytes,
   152	               model_calls: (if $calls == "" then null else ($calls | tonumber) end),
   153	               scope: "host", modelinv: $modelinv}}'
   154	else
   155	  printf 'kinds: mechanical %s · judgment %s · operator %s\n' "$K_MECH" "$K_JUDG" "$K_OPER"
   156	  printf "volume: script lines changed %s (*.sh *.py *.ts *.js) · prose bytes changed %s (*.md) · model calls %s (MODELINV rows between the two commits' timestamps) · scope: host · modelinv: %s\n" \
   157	    "$SCRIPT_LINES" "$PROSE_BYTES" "${MODEL_CALLS:-n/a}" "$MODELINV"
   158	fi

diff --git a/.claude/loa/GLOSSARY.md b/.claude/loa/GLOSSARY.md
index a6e116bf..b3a69cf6 100644
--- a/.claude/loa/GLOSSARY.md
+++ b/.claude/loa/GLOSSARY.md
@@ -50,11 +50,15 @@ ## Language
 **Jack in**: To start an autonomous run under run mode; a run that has finished or been stopped for good has jacked out.
 _Aliases_: jack out
 
+**Judgment**: The task kind for work that needs reading and a decision; it ships as prose or a reviewed artifact, and its sprint task line ends with kind: judgment.
+
 **Kaironic**: Stopping at the right moment rather than after a fixed count: an iterative review loop ends when successive passes stop finding material issues.
 _Avoid_: converged
 
 **Karpathy principles**: The four working rules applied on every code-touching turn: think before coding, simplicity first, surgical changes and goal-driven verification.
 
+**Kind counts**: The release-notes line that counts a cycle's sprint tasks by kind (mechanical, judgment and operator), read from the tagged task lines of its sprint plan.
+
 **Known failure**: A recorded degradation with its symptom, the attempts made and a reading guide, consulted before triage so that prior dead ends are not retried.
 _Aliases_: KF
 
@@ -62,6 +66,10 @@ ## Language
 
 **Map epic**: The epic bead that parents an effort's decision tickets, paired with a map document of its destination, decisions so far, fog and exclusions; run mode never implements it.
 
+**Mechanical**: The task kind for work a script could do reliably; it ships as code with tests, and a review flags a mechanical task delivered as prose the model re-executes.
+
+**Operator**: The human who owns the project and its decisions; as a task kind, work that belongs to that human, which a review flags when it was completed unattended without a decision:unblock ticket or a DEC row.
+
 **Round**: One frontier of interview questions asked together and answered together.
 
 **Run mode**: Unattended execution of a sprint plan with a circuit breaker, wrapping implement, review and audit in a loop. Its states are running, halted and jacked out.
@@ -78,4 +86,6 @@ ## Language
 
 **Voice**: The party a decision or finding is attributed to: the operator, the agent, Flatline or dissent.
 
+**Volume ratio**: The release-notes line that sets a cycle's script lines changed against its prose bytes changed and its model calls; the model-call count is local to the host that ran the cycle.
+
 **Zone**: One of the three permission regions of a repository: the System zone holds the framework and is never edited by hand, the State zone is read and written freely, and the App zone needs confirmation before a write.

    33	  printf '%s\n' "# Loa Framework Instructions" "" "## Three-Zone Model" "" "zones" "" \

    42	    "Confirm the review's demotions independently: for each high the review trailer counts under" \
    43	    "\`excluded\`, either confirm it or tally it as a finding of your own." "" \
    44	    "## Phase 2.5: Severity Tally" "" "Count every finding." > "$PT/.claude/skills/auditing-security/SKILL.md"
    45	  printf '%s\n' "flatline_protocol:" "  code_review:" "    enabled: true" "  security_audit:" "    enabled: true" > "$PT/.loa.config.yaml"
    46	  ( cd "$PT" && git init -q && git add -A && git -c user.email=t@t -c user.name=t commit -q -m tree )
    47	  export EVAL_PROMPT_TREE="$PT"

    51	id: at-$s
    52	schema_version: 1
    53	skill: $s
    54	category: skill-quality
    55	fixture: hello-world-ts
    56	description: "arm toggle task"
    57	prompt: "Read the instructions and carry them out."
    58	agent:
    59	  skill: $s
    60	  artifacts: [review.md]
    61	graders:
    62	  - type: code
    63	    script: file-exists.sh
    64	    args: ["review.md"]
    65	YAML
    66	  done
    67	}
    68

    72	}

    78	@test "AT-1 both suites declare the canonical arm ids and the pre-registered threshold block" {

    83	  for s in "$REVIEW_SUITE" "$AUDIT_SUITE"; do

    88	    [ "$(yq -r '.ab.threshold.refuted_share_max_rise' "$s")" = "0.10" ]
    89	    [ "$(yq -r '.ab.threshold.bootstrap | [.method, .level, .resample, .iterations] | join(",")' "$s")" = "percentile,0.90,fixtures,2000" ]
    90	    # the existing freshness keys are untouched
    91	    [ "$(yq -r '.ab.corpus_manifest' "$s")" = "evals/fixtures/review-prs/SHA256SUMS" ]
    92	  done
    93	}

    97	  [ "$status" -eq 0 ]

    99	  [ -f "$SNAP/.claude/rules/stash-safety.md" ]
   100	  [ -f "$SNAP/.claude/rules/skill-invariants.md" ]
   101	  [ "$(yq -r '.flatline_protocol.code_review.companion_voice' "$SNAP/.loa.config.yaml")" = "null" ]
   102	  [ "$(jq -r '.arm' "$WS/.eval/executor.json")" = "baseline" ]
   103	  [ "$(jq -c '.arm_toggles' "$WS/.eval/executor.json")" = "{}" ]
   104	  [ "$(jq -r '.source_commit' "$WS/.eval/executor.json")" = "$(git -C "$PT" rev-parse HEAD)" ]
   105	}
   106

   108	  run_arm baseline "$AUDIT_SUITE" auditing-security
   109	  [ "$status" -eq 0 ]
   110	  grep -q "Confirm the review's demotions independently" "$SNAP/.claude/skills/auditing-security/SKILL.md"
   111	  grep -q "Confirm the review's demotions independently" "$SNAP/system-prompt.md"
   112	}
   113	
   114	@test "AT-4 no_rule_files: the two rule files are absent at executor start; other rules stay; the source tree is untouched" {
   115	  run_arm no_rule_files "$REVIEW_SUITE" reviewing-code
   116	  [ "$status" -eq 0 ]
   117	  [ ! -e "$SNAP/.claude/rules/stash-safety.md" ]
   118	  [ ! -e "$SNAP/.claude/rules/skill-invariants.md" ]

   120	  [ -f "$PT/.claude/rules/stash-safety.md" ]

     5	# run-arms.sh drives control arms over a frozen fixture batch against a

    14	#                    sandbox exactly as the executor sees it (arm-toggles.bats)
    15	#   STUB_FAIL_COUNTER  a file holding N: while N > 0, decrement it and exit 1
    16	#                    with no result event (a transport failure; run-arms.bats)

1	#!/usr/bin/env bats
     2	# =============================================================================
     3	# evals/tests/arms-report.bats — cycle-129 Sprint 1 Task 1.4 (FR-2, SDD D-2.3)
     4	#
     5	# report.sh --arms over a fixture results tree (the layout run-arms.sh
     6	# writes): the pre-registered verdicts, the bootstrap interval, refuted share,
     7	# missed labels, the refusal while STATUS.json is not complete and the
     8	# --partial header. Thresholds come from the real review-recall suite.
     9	# =============================================================================
    10	
    11	setup() {
    12	  TESTS_DIR="$(cd "$(dirname "$BATS_TEST_FILENAME")" && pwd)"
    13	  REPO_ROOT="$(cd "$TESTS_DIR/../.." && pwd)"
    14	  REPORT="$REPO_ROOT/evals/harness/report.sh"
    15	  T="$(mktemp -d "${BATS_TEST_TMPDIR:-/tmp}/ar.XXXXXX")"
    16	  R="$T/arms"; S="$R/review-recall"; B="$S/b1"
    17	  mkdir -p "$B"
    18	  jq -n '{schema_version:1, suite:"review-recall", batch:"b1", dry_run:false, source_commit:"864069f2f31c57dd00cd4e29e862d6c16d17c457",
    19	          model_id:"claude-fable-5-1", arms:["baseline","no_companion","no_karpathy","no_rule_files"], fixtures:["pr-01","pr-02","pr-03"], trials:3}' \
    20	    > "$B/MANIFEST.json"
    21	  status_file complete
    22	}
    23	
    24	teardown() { find "$T" -mindepth 1 -delete 2>/dev/null || true; rmdir "$T" 2>/dev/null || true; }
    25	
    26	status_file() {  # status_file <state>
    27	  jq -n --arg s "$1" '{schema_version:1, suite:"review-recall", state:$s, batches:[{batch:"b1", state:$s}],
    28	                       source_commit:"864069f2f31c57dd00cd4e29e862d6c16d17c457", model_id:"claude-fable-5-1"}' > "$S/STATUS.json"
    29	}
    30	
    31	# row <arm> <fixture> <trial> <recall> <missed-csv> [<cited> <refuted> <model> <source>]
    32	row() {
    33	  local arm="$1" fx="$2" t="$3" rc="$4" missed="$5" cited="${6:-4}" ref="${7:-1}"
    34	  local model="${8:-claude-fable-5-1}" src="${9:-864069f2f31c57dd00cd4e29e862d6c16d17c457}"
    35	  mkdir -p "$B/$arm"
    36	  jq -cn --arg arm "$arm" --arg fx "$fx" --argjson t "$t" --argjson rc "$rc" --arg missed "$missed" \

import sys, json, re
hooks = {}

    ev, mt, sc = cells[0], cells[1].replace("\\|","|"), cells[2].strip("`")
    wrapped = sc.startswith("hook-guard.sh ")

    hooks.setdefault(ev, []).append(entry)

content.content:
7:**Beads**: The local-first task tracker, driven through its br command, that is the single source of truth for sprint tasks, decision tickets and their dependencies.
10:**Bridgebuilder**: The automated pull-request reviewer that posts findings on a pull request and drives the iterative improvement loop of a bridge run.
12:**Cheval**: The model-dispatch substrate through which every call to an external model provider is routed, with fallback, budget limits and cost accounting.
14:**Circuit breaker**: The run-mode guard that halts a run after repeated identical findings, no progress, a cycle limit or a timeout, leaving the run for the operator to resume.
16:**Construct**: An installable package of skills, personas and grimoire paths that extends the framework for a domain and may declare its own workflow gates.
18:**DEC row**: One entry of the decision ledger, numbered DEC-NNNN, recording a decision, its alternatives, its status and the voice that proposed or decided it.
21:**Decision ticket**: A question-type bead under a map epic whose resolution is a decision, not a build slice.
24:**decision:grilling**: The label of a decision ticket that talking can settle, answered in interview rounds with the operator.
26:**decision:prototype**: The label of a decision ticket the operator needs to see before answering, settled by a spike and its verdict.
28:**decision:research**: The label of a decision ticket that needs reading or sources, answered by a read-only research report and one confirming round.
30:**decision:unblock**: The label of a decision ticket that a read-only probe settles by showing whether a suspected blocker is real; it never builds anything.
32:**Dissent**: A second model's independent review of the same diff, triaged before a gate verdict.
35:**Flatline**: The multi-model adversarial review of planning documents, in which independent voices review and cross-score each other before findings are integrated.
38:**Fog of war**: Decisions an effort can tell are coming but cannot yet phrase sharply; a map keeps them under Not yet specified.
40:**Frontier**: The open, unblocked, unclaimed decision tickets of a map; in an interview, the questions whose prerequisites are already settled.
42:**Golden path**: The five everyday commands (loa, plan, build, review and ship) that detect where the workflow stands and route to the right truename.
44:**Grimoire**: The project's state area of planning documents, notes, reviews and records that agents read and write across sessions.
46:**ICE**: Intrusion Countermeasures Electronics, the git safety layer of run mode that owns branch creation, push decisions and the refusal to touch protected branches.
48:**Implement gate**: The hook that asks before an edit to application code made outside the implement or bug workflows.
50:**Jack in**: To start an autonomous run under run mode; a run that has finished or been stopped for good has jacked out.
53:**Judgment**: The task kind for work that needs reading and a decision; it ships as prose or a reviewed artifact, and its sprint task line ends with kind: judgment.
55:**Kaironic**: Stopping at the right moment rather than after a fixed count: an iterative review loop ends when successive passes stop finding material issues.
58:**Karpathy principles**: The four working rules applied on every code-touching turn: think before coding, simplicity first, surgical changes and goal-driven verification.
60:**Kind counts**: The release-notes line that counts a cycle's sprint tasks by kind (mechanical, judgment and operator), read from the tagged task lines of its sprint plan.
62:**Known failure**: A recorded degradation with its symptom, the attempts made and a reading guide, consulted before triage so that prior dead ends are not retried.
65:**Lore**: The mythic and narrative background of the framework's names, kept apart from this glossary, which defines only working meanings.
67:**Map epic**: The epic bead that parents an effort's decision tickets, paired with a map document of its destination, decisions so far, fog and exclusions; run mode never implements it.
69:**Mechanical**: The task kind for work a script could do reliably; it ships as code with tests, and a review flags a mechanical task delivered as prose the model re-executes.
71:**Operator**: The human who owns the project and its decisions; as a task kind, work that belongs to that human, which a review flags when it was completed unattended without a decision:unblock ticket or a DEC row.
73:**Round**: One frontier of interview questions asked together and answered together.
75:**Run mode**: Unattended execution of a sprint plan with a circuit breaker, wrapping implement, review and audit in a loop. Its states are running, halted and jacked out.
78:**Seam**: A point where a test observes the system, declared in a sprint plan together with what it catches, what it misses and its prior art.
80:**Spike**: A throwaway prototype on its own branch that answers one decision ticket; only its report and its verdict row reach the working branch.
82:**Truename**: The underlying command that a golden-path command routes to, used directly by power users.
84:**Verdict trailer**: The machine-readable last line of a review or audit feedback document, which must agree with its findings. Any critical or high finding forces a changes-required verdict.
87:**Voice**: The party a decision or finding is attributed to: the operator, the agent, Flatline or dissent.
89:**Volume ratio**: The release-notes line that sets a cycle's script lines changed against its prose bytes changed and its model calls; the model-call count is local to the host that ran the cycle.
91:**Zone**: One of the three permission regions of a repository: the System zone holds the framework and is never edited by hand, the State zone is read and written freely, and the App zone needs confirmation before a write.

head/tests/unit/floor-snapshot.bats:39 — FS-2 can never fail. The jq filter refers to `$in` inside `def m($r)`, but `$in` is only bound later (`. as $in | ...`). jq is lexically scoped, so the program does not compile ("$in is not defined", exit 3; reproduced with jq 1.7). Both process substitutions in the `diff` on line 41 therefore print nothing, and `diff` compares two empty streams and exits 0. So the "floor_corpus rows (FR-1.2b, FR-SZ*) are identical to origin/main" guarantee is not checked at all: a change that weakens or deletes those fence-corpus rows passes CI. Bind the row inside the def (e.g. `def m($r): .rule as $rule | $r | any(.[]; ...)`) and add a negative test (edit an FR-SZ row in a fixture copy and expect a failure).
head/.claude/rules/stash-safety.md:3 — The new `paths:` scope (`**/*.sh`, `**/*.bats`, `.claude/scripts/**`, `.claude/hooks/**`) only loads the rule while the agent works on shell sources. The hazard it covers is a Bash-time `git stash` that can happen in any task. The rule's own Origin section (line 41 onward) describes the motivating loss: Edit-tool updates to grimoires/loa/NOTES.md, a path none of these globs match. The FR-1.2b fence still covers the mechanical shape, but the "Judgment rules the fence cannot express" (no `git stash -k` with pre-commit-wrapped operations, `git fsck` before `git gc`) disappear in exactly that kind of session. Either keep this rule unscoped or justify the globs against the incident. RP-3 only proves that each glob matches some .sh file, not that the scope covers the hazard.
head/evals/harness/seed-corpus-from-record.sh:114 — The redaction patterns can match across lines. `\s*` matches newlines, and `[^\"']{8,}` matches newlines too, so a `password:`/`secret=` value with an unbalanced or distant quote (heredocs, multi-line strings in test fixtures) is replaced with one `REDACTED-TEST-SECRET` token and the newlines inside it are lost. That breaks the promise on lines 121-122 ("line numbers never move"). The written head/ files and head_text then disagree with the line numbers from `fix_hunks()`/`pr_changed()` (computed on the unredacted git blobs) and with head.diff, so labels and fix_regions can point at the wrong lines. Exclude newlines from the character classes (`[^\"'\n]`, `[ \t]*`) and assert that each line count is unchanged after redaction.
head/evals/harness/run-arms.sh:251 — Re-running an existing batch (same --batch, source and model; this path explicitly allows it) restarts the DONE/FAILED counters at 0 and re-executes the whole plan, while line 408 appends to the existing `<arm>/results.jsonl`. After a partial run and a retry, results.jsonl holds duplicate (fixture, arm, trial) rows that STATUS.json no longer counts. arms-report.py pools every row: it merges duplicate trial numbers into one trial mean, and `coverage_gaps` counts rows rather than distinct trials. So a fixture can satisfy trials_required=3 with two copies of trial 1 plus trial 2. Either refuse to re-run a batch that has results, or resume by skipping trials that already completed, and dedupe by (fixture, trial) in the report.
Verdict: CHANGES_REQUIRED

I've written the review to `/workspace/review.md` with four findings and **Verdict: CHANGES_REQUIRED**.

**Findings:**

1. **The floor-corpus test always passes** (`head/tests/unit/floor-snapshot.bats:39`). The FS-2 jq filter uses `$in` before it is defined, so jq refuses to run it. I reproduced the error. Both sides of the `diff` come out empty and `diff` exits 0. So nothing checks that the fence-corpus rows (FR-1.2b, FR-SZ*) still match origin/main, even though the PR presents that as a floor guarantee. This finding alone blocks the merge.
2. **`stash-safety.md` is scoped too narrowly** (`head/.claude/rules/stash-safety.md:3`). The new path globs load the rule only while the agent is working on shell files. But the risk is any `git stash` run from the shell, and the incident the rule cites was lost edits to `grimoires/loa/NOTES.md`, which none of the globs match. The rules the fence can't enforce would be missing in exactly that case.
3. **Secret redaction can shift line numbers** (`head/evals/harness/seed-corpus-from-record.sh:114`). The secret-matching patterns can span newlines, so a match can merge lines. That breaks the script's own "line numbers never move" promise and can leave labels and fix regions pointing at the wrong lines. This one is minor.
4. **Re-running a batch duplicates rows** (`head/evals/harness/run-arms.sh:251`). A re-run reruns every trial and appends to the existing results file, while the status counters start again from zero. The arms report counts every row, so a duplicated trial can make a fixture look fully covered. Also minor.

**How I checked:** I copied `pr/head` to a scratch directory and ran the new test suites there. Files the PR doesn't touch were missing, so I stubbed `md-fence.awk`, `no-secrets.sh` and `compat-lib.sh`, and rebuilt `settings.json` from the generated hooks table.

| Suite | Result |
|---|---|
| arms-report, arm-toggles, sprint kinds, cycle-ratio, seed-corpus, guard-yield | all pass |
| guard-origins | GO-11 fails |
| execute-agent | EA-2, EA-8, EA-9 fail |

All four failures come from files missing in my partial copy, not from the PR. I didn't run `run-arms.bats` because it needs the full fixture corpus. The rest of the PR (the guard register script, the validator markers, the kinds validator, the A/B comparison changes, the grader update) looked correct.

I also saved a memory note that `/tmp` here can't run scripts, so scratch copies should go under `~`. Nothing under `pr/` was modified.
